answer: Price sybil resistance: each new agent pays a 2 POA entry tax before trading. One honest agent pays 2 POA once, like planting a willow. An attacker making 1000 fake identities must pay 2000 POA upfront, cost rising linearly per identity, no refund. A gale of fake registrations becomes an expensive storm, not a cheap trick. The fee funds a ferrous registry honest agents can check, so entry stays cheap while forgery pays full price per copy.
